title: A trial to learn how well AZD0120 works and about its safety in adults with transplant eligible newly diagnosed multiple myeloma.
official: A Phase III, Open-label, Multicentre, Randomised Study Comparing Consolidation Treatment with AZD0120, an Autologous Dual Targeting Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell (CAR-T) Therapy Directed Against BCMA and CD19, versus Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT) in Participants with Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma who are Transplant Eligible (TE NDMM) (DURGA-6)
summary:
Primary Objective 1:
To demonstrate the superiority of single administration of AZD0120 compared with ASCT as consolidation followed by lenalidomide maintenance by assessment of PFS in participants with TE NDMM.

Primary Objective 2:
To demonstrate the superiority of single administration of AZD0120 compared with ASCT as consolidation followed by lenalidomide maintenance by assessment of MRD negative CR rate at 9 months in participants with TE NDMM.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be at least 18 years, at the time of signing the ICF.
2. ECOG performance status score of 0 or 1.
3. Participant must be eligible for treatment with high-dose melphalan (200 mg/m²) followed by ASCT.
4. Participant must have adequate organ and bone marrow function (as detailed in CSP Table 9).
5. Participant must have documented measurable disease at diagnosis, as defined by any of the following: (a) Serum M-protein level ≥ 1.0 g/dL (b) Urine M-protein level ≥ 200 mg/24 hour (c) Serum Ig FLC ≥ 10 mg/dL (100 mg/L) and abnormal serum Ig kappa lambda FLC ratio.
6. Participant must have documented diagnosis of NDMM, per IMWG diagnostic criteria, and must have completed 4 to 6 cycles of approved induction therapy (anti-CD38+VRd, DVTd, DRd or VRd) prior to randomisation.
7. Participant must have at least SD or better per IMWG 2016 after completion of induction, and prior to randomisation.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participant has a known active, or prior history of central nervous system involvement or exhibits clinical signs of meningeal involvement of MM.
2. Participant has primary amyloidosis, active plasma cell leukaemia at time of screening, Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia or POEMS syndrome.
3. Participant has significant neurological or psychiatriccondition within 6 months before signing ICF.
4. Participant has any other significant medical condition which, in the opinion of the investigator, places the participant at an unacceptable risk for treatment-related complications, could interfere with the successful or safe delivery of therapy, or could interfere with evaluation of study intervention or interpretation of participant safety or study results.
5. Participants who required the introduction of an additional agent due to inadequate response.
6. Prior treatment with CAR-T and/or CAR-natural killer cell therapies directed at any target for any indications and any therapy that is targeted to BCMA and CD19.
7. Participant received any prior T-cell engager therapy directed at any target.
